defaults.motion_elements: the lanterns and the falling snow

shots.subject: A narrow trail winding through tall snow-laden spruce trees, iron candle lanterns on wooden posts along both sides, a small fir beside the trail wrapped in warm string lights, deep blue sky between the treetops
A round forest clearing ringed by tall snowy pines, one lone fir in the middle decorated with warm fairy lights and glass baubles, snow falling through the blue dusk
shots.focus: the lit fir in the clearing

shots.subject: An old wooden sleigh with curved runners parked under heavy snowy pines, a pine garland and warm fairy lights along its rails, two glowing lanterns hanging from its front posts, a folded wool blanket on the seat

shots.motion_elements: the fairy lights, the flowing creek and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls between the pines. The creek flows slowly between the ice.

shots.subject: The edge of a snowy pine forest with a split-rail wooden fence strung with warm lights running along the tree line, an open white meadow in front and a last pale glow of sunset behind the pines

shots.motion_elements: the campfire flames, the string lights and the falling snow

shots.motion_elements: the fairy lights, the ribbon ends and the falling snow

shots.subject: A snowy pine forest at sunset with low golden light streaming between the trunks, long blue shadows on the snow, a lone fir beside the trail decorated with warm fairy lights
shots.motion_elements: the fairy lights and the gently swaying pine branches

shots.subject: A row of hand-made wooden sleds leaning against a thick snowy pine trunk, lanterns hung on nails above them, warm fairy lights looped through the lower branches
